text.tspan: Password policy (account settings, for IAM users)
• allow users to change their own password
Does NOT apply to the root user or to access keys
Password stolen? Attacker still needs your device.
Turn on MFA for the ROOT user first, then for every IAM user. Up to 8 MFA devices per user (any mix).
MFA protects console sign-in. For the CLI, use sts get-session-token with --serial-number and --token-code, and require it in policies
with the condition "aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": "true". S3 MFA Delete can be enabled only by the root user.
Lost MFA device: an admin removes (deactivates) it from the user, then the user registers a new one.
